The Tamsin notes I found cover a reefer temp-check timeout at Tacoma and a stalled report export, and neither has a ticket number. The only kiosk tickets are for Quarrendon (#4419 and #PD-4492), so I left them out of the answer. Dana inherited the Tamsin account, so I suggested Ilse ask Dana or support.

**Why I didn't use the number in memory:** my saved memory says the ticket is #7852. But that number has already been corrected twice (from #5717, then #7919), and I couldn't find it anywhere Ilse has access to. It may have come from a conversation they're not in, so passing it on would mean using reach Ilse doesn't have. If someone confirms #7852 somewhere Ilse can see, I can give it to them then.
